chunks: 4969 - It is narrated from Hisham ibn Salim, from Uqbah, who said:

Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said: "The glance is a poisoned arrow from the arrows of Iblis. Whoever abandons it for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, not for other than Him, Allah will cause him to inherit a faith whose taste he finds."

key_terms.إِيمَانًا: Faith granted by Allah as a spiritual consequence of sincere restraint.
key_terms.النَّظْرَةُ: A glance, especially one directed toward what is forbidden.
key_terms.سِهَامِ إِبْلِيسَ: The means by which Iblis tempts and harms human beings spiritually.
key_terms.طَعْمَهُ: Its taste; the inward sweetness and experiential reality of faith.

ai.seo_question: What reward is promised for lowering one's gaze for the sake of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a forbidden glance is a dangerous spiritual temptation, likened to one of the poisoned arrows of Iblis. If a person abandons it purely for the sake of Allah, Allah grants him iman whose sweetness he inwardly experiences.
